flows.title: Add a contact form to a site
steps: Click Form to create a new Form element.
Optionally enter one or more Recipient Email addresses, up to five and comma-separated, to have this form's messages sent somewhere other than the default.
Optionally check Filter messages to automatically filter out messages with common spam content.
Optionally click the Fields tab to rename or toggle the form's fields.
Optionally click the Button tab to change the form's submit button Label.

flows.title: Publish a site to a custom domain
steps: The custom domain must already be registered before Carrd can use it.
Set Action to Publish to a custom domain.
Enter the domain name exactly as you want it to appear in the address bar, either domain.ext or www.domain.ext. The version you do not use forwards to the other automatically.
Scroll down to locate the site's DNS records, then set those records up at your domain provider so they point the domain at the Carrd site.
Back at Carrd, click Publish Changes.
